text.p: Nile Pharmaceuticals and Chemical Industries will pay a dividend of 4.60 pounds per share for the financial year 1995/96, a company statement published on Wednesday said.
It said the dividend, agreed at the annual general meeting on November 21, would be paid from December 19 through Banque du Caire. Dividends for 1994/5 were 4.00 pounds.

The company announced last month that it made net profits of 29.018 million pounds ($8.5 million) in 1995/96, up 48.9 percent on 19.494 million pounds in the previous year. The financial year ends on June 30.
Last year, as part of its privatisation programme, the state sold off 600,000 shares or 20 percent of the firm -- 300,000 to the public at 56.70 pounds a share and 300,000 to employees.
